baseline_prompt_en: Create a contemporary photographic portrait of a person with reference-guided facial appearance and hair, portrayed as a fictional woman in her late twenties, dressed in layered autumn fashion. Her rounded-oval face, brown eyes, small straight nose and softly defined lips follow the visible reference cues. Her short black bob and wispy forehead bangs retain the reference's visible hair shape. The reference guides her facial appearance and hair. She is caught in a complex, causally connected moment on the small flat roof of a brick neighborhood weather observatory, saving a hand-plotted paper chart that a sudden cold gust has lifted from its reading board. A dark weather front gathers beyond the roof, and a simple wind vane above the parapet points across the same gust. She stands just to the right of a waist-high wooden work shelf fixed to the brick parapet. Both feet are planted on the dry roof, one slightly ahead of the other, and a small turn through her hips brings her shoulders toward the shelf. The wooden chartboard tilts upward from the shelf toward her. Her right hand pushes a hinged brass retaining bar down over the chart's top margin while her left palm pins its center against the tilted wooden board. The captured upper margin lies straight under the bar; the lower right corner is still caught in a curling gust, revealing a sliver of the wood underneath. Dark hand-drawn plot lines remain readable as a graph across the exposed paper. She looks toward the closing bar with concentrated brown eyes, a faint release of tension at one corner of her mouth as the paper begins to stay in place. Her face remains visible in three-quarter view, with a few fine bangs separating in the wind. An open cinnamon-brown brushed-wool coat has a substantial notched collar, softly rounded shoulder seams and visible matte fibers catching the low afternoon light. Inside its open lapels, a moss-green ribbed roll-neck sweater forms a distinct inner layer; its narrow ribbed cuffs extend beyond the coat sleeves around her wrists. A charcoal knife-pleated midi skirt emerges below the coat's mid-thigh hem. Most folds fall vertically, while the gust opens a small fan of pleats along one side of the skirt. Dark brown leather ankle boots show gently creased vamps and low stacked heels against the roof's mineral surface. The wool, knitted ribs, pressed skirt folds and smooth worn leather keep their own textures and weight as she works. Use a vertical full-body frame with both boots inside the picture, the chartboard offset to the left and the woman's unobstructed coat-to-skirt layers to the right. Photograph from an oblique front position near chest height with a natural 50 mm perspective. Her face, both hands, the bar-to-paper contact and the visible garment textures share useful sharpness; the distant rooftops soften gently. Cool skylight fills the roof while a low warm break in the clouds brushes her cheek, the bob's outer edge and the wool lapel. Keep the dominant impression of a particular person completing a small necessary task in changing weather, with autumn dress carrying the same wind and light as the paper.
